title: Binding entry (CONTRACT.md 4.7, operations profile)
description: One reference that did not bind, in the `bindings` of a `binding` refusal: the port it came through (null for an artifact read), its 0-based index within a `many` port, the problem, what the port takes and what it was given, and what a person can do.

port.description: The in-port, `artifact` for export, null for a read of the artifact resource.

index.description: The item's 0-based position; present only for items of a `many` port.

expected.description: What the port takes, for people (a type and version).

got.description: What it was given, for people (a type and version, or an identity).

remedy.description: A sentence a person can act on; required for `unresolved`.
